sent_emails.subject: Question about one of your Arkansas hunts
sent_emails.body:
Clifton,
I’m Craig Ramos, working with Whitetail Syndicate. I came across On Your Own Outdoors and the public-land hunts you share in Arkansas.
We’re putting together real stories from whitetail hunters. I’m interested in the hunt somebody still talks about, whether they got the deer, missed it, or something else happened that stuck with them.
Is there one of your own hunts you’d be open to telling me about? I’d like to hear it from you first, then we could talk about whether it makes sense to do a full story.
If it’s not a fit, no problem. I won’t keep emailing you.
Craig Ramos
